author: ampaubeo

title: a great app that has many improvements over time
body:
i have been using finch for almost a year, and decided to purchase a subscription to support the team, and this is how much i do find the app really intuitive

the only downside to this is how limited the ux may seem, as with the concept of a “self-care” app, a lot of people will find struggling to even think how can they use this, especially the people who already have issues with even “self-care” in general. because of this, the app being quite mandatory for the users to have like go out and do a learning curve to see what the developers have developed all through the time, is quite adding onto this vagueness about “self-care” that a lot of people have already had troubles for (my brain is kinda stopped now due to a full work day so i hope that makes sense)

a way to address this would probably make a mission like task for new users to add suggested goals, and add goals on their owns (and other functions of the app) think like a game tutorial but can be like a first week user check in that is like permanent event in all online based video games now? also finch’s new idea is to roll out dedicated goals for each month’s campaign is good too as it let people see how creative people can be with the self care goals they can have, and be intrigued with the finch system!!

other than that, the app has been very helpful for my journey to recover from my experiences of cptsd recently : ) and many more. the app is also limited to english users for now but it will help the development’s consistency so i dont think it is really an issue : )
